北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴，29℃，阳光正好，户外注意防晒和补水哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny, 29℃. Enjoy the sun, remember sun protection & hydration!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波阴天，29℃ 偏湿热，注意保持清爽，室内可开窗通风。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo is cloudy, 29℃ and humid. Stay cool and consider ventilating indoors.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴，26℃，体感偏热伴高湿，注意除湿，保持舒适哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, 26℃ with high humidity making it feel warmer. Stay comfy and dehumidify!
上海.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴，28℃，风力较大，出门注意防风，小心着凉哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy, 28℃ with strong winds. Be mindful of the wind when out and about!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴，29℃，湿度稍高，注意室内通风，保持清爽。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, 29℃ with higher humidity. Keep indoors ventilated and stay fresh.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴，26℃，湿度很高哦，出门记得带伞，注意防潮。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, 26℃ with very high humidity. Don't forget your umbrella and mind the dampness.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴，26℃，风力不小，出门小心被风吹到，带好雨具哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy, 26℃ with strong winds. Be careful of the wind and bring rain gear!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，33℃，体感高达36℃，炎热，多喝水防暑哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is partly cloudy, 33℃ but feels like 36℃. It's hot, so stay hydrated and prevent heatstroke!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴，31℃，风力6级，外出注意防风，避免着凉感冒哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, 31℃ with strong winds. Be careful of the wind and avoid catching a cold!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴，31℃，体感 34℃，阳光强烈，务必多补水，防晒。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny, 31℃ but feels like 34℃. Strong sun, remember to hydrate and protect from sun!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，34℃，体感 37℃！太热了，务必多喝水防暑！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is partly cloudy, 34℃ but feels like 37℃! It's scorching hot, please hydrate and stay cool!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阴，21℃，体感舒适，户外活动适时添减衣物哦。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy, 21℃ with comfortable weather. Dress appropriately for outdoor activities!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴，26℃，阳光正好，户外游玩注意补水和防晒哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny, 26℃. Enjoy the sunshine, remember to hydrate and use sun protection!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，26℃，天气宜人，外出散步，感受好天气吧！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is partly cloudy, 26℃ with pleasant weather. Enjoy a walk outside!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门小雨，25℃，出门请带伞，风力较大，注意防风保暖。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen has light rain, 25℃. Bring an umbrella, strong winds, stay warm!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，29℃ 左右，体感舒适，户外不错，记得补水。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is partly cloudy, 29℃ with comfortable weather. Great for outdoors, remember to hydrate!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴，27℃，风力不小，出门记得防风，享受阳光哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny, 27℃ with strong winds. Remember wind protection and enjoy the sun!

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦大雨，体感只有 19℃，务必带好雨具，注意保暖防寒。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu has heavy rain, feels like 19℃. Essential to bring rain gear and stay warm!
漳浦.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃ | 💨 北风警报：西北风 4级

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，29℃ 偏湿热，注意保持清爽，室内可开窗通风。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy, 29℃ and humid. Stay cool and consider ventilating indoors.
